Dual Windows release: Houdini-linked build plus bundled OptiX build.

### Highlights

- **Houdini build** — Keeps the full existing SideFX/Houdini `idenoise` workflow, including OIDN/OptiX backend selection, temporal controls, SideFX options, EXR mode, Houdini discovery, `hoiiotool` AOV scanning, and custom executable support
- **OptiX build** — Adds a Houdini-free Windows package with a bundled metadata-preserving OptiX multipart EXR denoiser
- **Release workflow** — Publishes both package zips to the same GitHub release and records both source SHAs plus the pinned denoiser SHA
- **Packaging** — Uses clear artifact names: `h-denoise-houdini-windows-x64-vX.Y.Z.zip` and `h-denoise-optix-windows-x64-vX.Y.Z.zip`

### Package guide

Download the Houdini zip if you want the existing full SideFX feature set.

Download the OptiX zip if you want a standalone GPU denoise build without installing or discovering Houdini. In this first OptiX release, advanced temporal/GPU options remain future work unless separately validated.
